
```{r}
#Data for maps
#Coastline
coast <- st_read("data/Greece_geology/Greece/land_poly_GR.gpkg",quiet = TRUE) %>%  st_transform(crs = "WGS84") 
coast_km<-  st_transform(coast, crs = 32635);  
st_geometry(coast_km) <- st_geometry(coast_km) / 1000  
```

## Mesh sensitivity analysis 
Because the area have several islands and a complex coastline we will implement a barrier mesh. 
 
To optimize mesh characteristics, we followed the empirical recommendations of Zuur et al. (2017), Zuur & Ieno (2018) and H. Baka repository (https://haakonbakkagit.github.io/, accessed 30-09-2025). Specifically, 
 
The cutoff distance should be approximately 1/5 of the max.edge of the inner area.
The max.edge can be approximated as 1/5 of an expected/guessed autocorrelation range.
The resolution of the outer area can be lower, with a general recommended inner-to-outer ratio of 1:5. 
Offset is recommended to extend to 2/3 of the expected range.

We run a sensitivity analysis to select the optimal mesh.

First we assume an expected/guessed autocorrelation range of 23nmi (42.5Km) and flowing the above recommendations we fit
M0:log(μs,t) = αt + ωs + εs,t 

For 42.5km assumed range max.edge=8.51 km

Following we fitted the same model with several meshes of higher and lower resolutions:
  max.edge= 3 km
  max.edge= 5 km
  max.edge= 10 km
  max.edge= 15 km
  max.edge= 20 km

Models are compared using the AIC criterion and the mesh that resulted to the model fit with the lower AIC was selected for the main a analysis.

First we fit the meshes
```{r}
poly.coast <- coast  # Greek shp WGS84
stations_sf <- st_as_sf(data.eggs, coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326)

# Plot points for check
plot(stations_sf$geometry, pch=19, col=2)

# Create a convex hull polygon around all stations
transect_poly <- st_convex_hull(st_union(stations_sf))

# Buffer around the transect polygon (e.g., 0.1 degrees ~ ~10km depending on latitude)
buff <- st_buffer(transect_poly, dist = 10000)  # WGS84 degrees; or use UTM for meters

# Plot the buffer
plot(buff, col = "lightblue", border = "blue")
plot(stations_sf$geometry, add = TRUE, pch = 19, col = 2)
 
output = st_intersection(buff,poly.coast)
plot(output,col=3)
domain = st_difference(transect_poly,st_union(output))
domain = st_sf(domain)

domain_utm <- st_transform(domain, "+init=epsg:32635 +units=km")
plot(domain_utm,col=4,axes=T)
plot(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, pch="+",add=T)
```

### bspde3 - assumed range 3km
```{r}
# build the mesh with coastline
max.edge = 3 #km 
bound.outer = 10
mesh_high = inla.mesh.2d(
                         boundary = domain_utm,
                         loc = cbind(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y),
                         max.edge = c(1,5)*max.edge,
                         cutoff = max.edge/5,
                         offset = c(max.edge, bound.outer)
                         )
plot(mesh_high, lwd=0.5, axes = T); points(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, col="red")
mesh_high <- make_mesh(data.eggs, c("X", "Y"), mesh = mesh_high)
plot(mesh_high, lwd=0.5, axes = T); points(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, col="red")

# Add on the barrier mesh component
poly.coast_utm <- st_transform(poly.coast, "+init=epsg:32635 +units=km")
bspde <- add_barrier_mesh(
  spde_obj = mesh_high,
  barrier_sf = poly.coast_utm,
  range_fraction = 0.1,
  proj_scaling = 1,
  plot = TRUE)

plot(bspde, lwd=0.5, axes = T); points(data.eggs$X, data.eggs$Y, col="red")

#We can make a more advanced plot if we want:
mesh_df_water <- bspde$mesh_sf[bspde$normal_triangles, ]
mesh_df_land <- bspde$mesh_sf[bspde$barrier_triangles, ]

xlims2 <- c(200,400)
ylims2 <- c(4350,4550)

ggplot(poly.coast_utm) +
  geom_sf() +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_df_water, size = .1, colour = "blue") +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_df_land, size = .1, colour = "green") +
  coord_sf(xlim = xlims2, ylim = ylims2)

bspde3 <- bspde
```

### range_based

```{r}
bound.outer = range_est*(2/3)
```

# Fit the models
## MODEL 3km
```{r}
fit_m0_3 <- sdmTMB(
 eggs0_abu ~ 1 + (1|Year),
  data = data.eggs,
  mesh = bspde3,
  family = tweedie(link = "log"),
  spatial = "on",
  spatiotemporal = "IID",   
  time = "time")

model_fit<- fit_m0_3
model_code="m0_3"

sanity(model_fit)
model_fit  

tidy(model_fit, effects = "ran_pars", conf.int = TRUE)
```

## Compare models 

AIC
```{r}
models <- list(  m0_3=      fit_m0_3,
                 m0_5=      fit_m0_5,   
                 m0_range = fit_m0_range, 
                 m0_10 =    fit_m0_10,  
                 m0_15=     fit_m0_15, 
                 m0_20=     fit_m0_20)


AIC_df <- tibble(
  model = names(models),
  AIC = sapply(models, AIC)
) %>% mutate(ΔAIC = AIC - min(AIC))

AIC_df<- AIC_df %>% filter(model %in% c("m0_3","m0_5","m0_range","m0_10","m0_15", "m0_20")) %>% mutate(ΔAIC = AIC - min(AIC))


caic_0_20<-cAIC(fit_m0.2_20)
caic_0_15<-cAIC(fit_m0.2_15)
caic_0_10<-cAIC(fit_m0.2_10)
caic_0_range<-cAIC(fit_m0.2_range)
caic_0_5<-cAIC(fit_m0.2_5)
# caic_0.2_3<-cAIC(fit_m0.2_3) No possible to run because of computer memory

cAIC <- tibble (
    model= c("m0_3","m0_5","m0_range","m0_10","m0_15", "m0_20"),
    cAIC= c(caic_0_3,caic_0_5,caic_0_range,caic_0_10,caic_0_15,caic_0_20))
    %>% mutate(ΔcAIC = cAIC - min(cAIC,na.rm=T))

AIC_df %>% filter(model %in% c("m0_3","m0_5","m0_range","m0_10","m0_15", "m0_20"))
cAIC_df 
```
